description: This file defines an abstract superclass 'AuditModel' that provides auditing functionality, including tracking creation and update timestamps, for other entity classes in a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: AuditModel
classes.description: An abstract base class annotated with JPA and Jackson annotations, providing createdAt and updatedAt timestamp fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp of the entity.
